files.native/: not committed; setup downloads @oh-my-pi/pi-natives-<platform>@18.1.16 (darwin-arm64, linux-x64 baseline/modern) from npm
files.shake.ts: pi-agent-core compaction/shake.ts + tool-protection.ts + session-maintenance.ts shake orchestration
files.soft.ts: soft = Pi built-in summarizer; only snapcompact-archive migration + file-list merge ported

localChanges: remote: unsupported on Pi (no provider-native compaction transport); /compact remote notifies and falls back to soft
soft: uses Pi's own summary prompt/format instead of OMP's prompts; OMP's short summary and fold-window summarization not ported
Pi runs /compact itself; modes are parsed from customInstructions in session_before_compact
/handoff commits through Pi's ctx.compact, which aborts a running turn first (OMP does not)
shake persists through Pi context_edit entries; originals saved to <sessionDir>/omp-shake/*.md and recovered with read, not artifact://
auto shake that frees enough context cancels Pi's compaction (shows as cancelled); on overflow it always continues to the next method so the turn is retried
no idle or incomplete-output triggers, no speculative pre-threshold compaction: Pi has no hooks for them
